attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: finished panoramic background painting for a fantasy game's forced-exploration scene. Generate ONE landscape illustration, exact 3:1 canvas, ideally 3072x1024 or larger. Input image 1 is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its major arrangement, horizon, perspective and crop-safe landmarks, repaint as refined Japanese/Korean anime game background art with delicate lines, soft cel-painted gradients and restrained texture. Night, viewed from inside a ruined room with broken masonry walls framing the outer edges and shattered floorboards/rubble along the bottom. An EMPTY wooden chair at x=29%, small wooden writing desk at x=20%, and fallen teddy bear at x=21% belong to the ruined room on the left. All three must remain visible inside the x=17% to x=65% narrow-screen crop. Beyond the missing wall, a misty European-inspired city with blue-gray mansard roofs, distant cathedral spires and a civic plaza with an equestrian statue fountain at x=57%. Large blue planet in the upper LEFT sky, beautiful luminous GOLD elliptical orbital trails sweeping across the upper middle. Deep indigo, muted slate blue, teal fog, subtle warm window lights and gold orbit accents. Keep the right foreground third relatively quiet, darker and free of prominent subjects so a separate rear-view character can be overlaid. Make the chair-to-fountain composition readable at a small banner size. Full-bleed image, no letterboxing. No humans or characters, no writing, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. All ages. Do not reproduce any unrelated game character or real person.

Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Edit target: supplied current lavistar_ruin_bg_1.png, a panoramic anime fantasy background. Redraw ONLY the sky, preserving the composition, exact aspect ratio 3:1 (2172x724 preferred), architecture, all foreground props and original delicate painted style. Completely REMOVE the blue planet and ALL its diagonal orbital trails; no planet, moon, spherical celestial body, or orbital swoosh anywhere. Replace them with ONE gigantic GOLDEN PROTECTIVE RING hanging across the upper LEFT-to-CENTER sky: a clearly readable closed circular shield perimeter seen in gentle perspective as a broad ellipse, centered around x=40%, y=19%, spanning approximately x=21%-61%, y=3%-38%. Its upper and lower arcs together must unmistakably read as one enclosing circle, not diagonal streaks and not a planet's orbit. This ring has guarded the world for ages and is NOW SHATTERING: deep cracks across its substantial luminous gold rim, missing segments and detached gold shards falling from the broken upper-left/central arcs; through the broken shield gaps reveal dark crimson-violet cosmic void. Sky itself breaks like enormous glass panes, subtle fractured spacetime and scattered falling stars/light splinters, apocalypse of the cosmos. Focus the most legible fracture around x=34%-43%, y=10%-22%, along the future character's upper-left gaze. Rich indigo/cool blue, restrained red-violet void and gold-white fractures; dramatic but balanced airy luminance so the misty city and foreground remain readable as a small top-of-screen banner. Keep the LOWER SCENE essentially unchanged: ruined room at left, empty wooden chair, small desk and teddy bear; central misty European city with equestrian statue plaza; preserve chair through plaza within x=17%-65% narrow-screen crop. Keep right foreground third quiet for a separate rear-view Gwen overlay; do not add Gwen or any character. Preserve existing perspective, horizon, furniture positions, masonry framing, blue roofs, warm windows, fog and floorboards. Full-bleed landscape, absolutely 3:1. No text, lettering, logos, watermark or labels. One edited background only.
references: lavistar_ruin_bg_v1.png (5e05a3f source; edit target; outside repository)

attempts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE finished panoramic fantasy game background at native 3:1 resolution, at least 1800x600, ideally 2160x720. Input 1 (office) is the PRIMARY STYLE and GOLD RING reference: match its clean visible dark outlines, flat shapes and only 2-3 cel shading tones. Inputs 2 and 3 are Gwen SD STYLE references: match the crisp outlines, navy/teal/gold palette, restrained shading, no painterly detail. Input 4 is COMPOSITION/CONTENT reference only: redraw that ruined room and city in the office/SD style. Same set as the office. Left: ruined room, EMPTY simple wooden chair near x29%, small writing desk near x20%, fallen teddy bear x21%, rubble and broken floorboards. Middle: misty simplified European city, equestrian statue fountain plaza near x57%. Right foreground third relatively empty for a separately composited back-facing Gwen, NO people in this image. Preserve these landmarks within horizontal x17%-65% crop. Sky: NO planet. One enormous circular GOLD SHIELD RING in perspective as a broad flattened ellipse, same simple solid golden band and angular breaks as office window ring, NO ornate engraving. Place entire ring between x22%-61%, y15%-44%, centered upper left-middle; this lower sky placement is essential for narrow-screen cropping. It is actively SHATTERING: obvious major rupture at x34% y22%, detached angular golden chunks falling, red-violet void visible through jagged cracks, sky cracking like glass, falling stars. Apocalyptic but all ages. Sky fissures and stars are clean graphic line shapes; no photographic nebula, no bloom or complex particles. Keep the city and room calm simple flat navy/teal shapes, gold accents. Visible clean dark contour lines around objects, 2-3 hard-edged tones. NO painterly strokes, texture, grain, gloss, realistic tiny details, gradients or ornate filigree. No text, lettering, logos, watermark. Output the native image, do not upscale.

attempts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Input image 2 (official Gwen chair artwork) is costume/whole-body reference only. Input image 3 (temporary rear-view cutout) is POSE AND SILHOUETTE reference only, replace its harder glossy style with the soft approved art style. Full body, head to boots with modest transparent margins, approximately portrait 2:3 canvas. Gwen stands calmly with her BACK to the viewer in a slight three-quarter rear view; head gently turned toward the UPPER LEFT of the image, looking away over a distant city. Keep most of the face hidden, a small soft cheek/profile and one restrained golden eye if naturally visible, never looking at viewer. Keep the pose and costume silhouette close to reference 3, a narrow draped black/gold shoulder-back panel instead of a large cape. Adult anime woman, natural approved full-size proportions (not chibi), round soft face, short small chin, delicate outlines, soft cel shading plus restrained gradients. Dark INDIGO/PURPLE NAVY bob (#1E1B4B to #2A2560), teal inner hair behind ear, small gold bar hairpin on HER anatomical LEFT side (visible near image-left temple in this rear view). Royal-blue tailored military uniform, gold fringed epaulettes, teal neck ribbon with red diamond jewel (only visible as pose permits), white layered jabot at front (do not paste it onto the back), black double waist belt, teal sash, blue skirt/coat tails with white edging, pale tights and dark boots. White gloves with white frilled cuffs. Each sleeve has ONE BROAD WHITE BAND on its OUTER face from below shoulder all the way to just before wrist frill, no inner-sleeve stripes. Arms at ease, one gloved hand visible hanging on image-left, other naturally at waist. Upper 62 percent of the alpha-trimmed body (head through mid-thigh) will be cropped for production: prioritize perfect bob silhouette, epaulettes, upper-back uniform, sleeve stripe continuity, hands and waist. Soft cool night illumination and very subtle warm rim from upper left, keep royal blue and navy recognizable. No floor, cast ground shadow, scenery, background or fake checkerboard. No text, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. All ages; no sexualization, no real person, no unrelated game character. Exactly one character.

Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied rear-view full-body Gwen illustration. Preserve the SAME character, costume, hairstyle, gold pin, pose, hand anatomy, proportions, linework, blue/teal/gold colors and complete boots. Remove ALL of the diffuse cloudy gray/blue/purple/gold glow surrounding her. Output a CLEAN CHARACTER CUTOUT with genuine RGBA transparency: every pixel outside the physical silhouette of hair, epaulettes, clothing, hands, legs and boots must be fully transparent alpha=0. The character's solid interiors must be opaque alpha=255; only actual narrow anti-aliased edges may have partial alpha. NO ambient aura, NO haze, NO blurry halo, NO shadow, NO vignette, NO background, NO checkerboard baked into pixels. The transparent gaps between limbs must also be completely clear. Keep the existing delicate illustration shading inside the character, and keep full body plus small transparent margins. Only additional pose adjustment: lift her chin very slightly so her eye gaze clearly goes to UPPER LEFT, still looking away with her back to viewer. Do not add any object, text, logo or watermark. All ages. ONE character on a portrait transparent canvas.
